'''Zerex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Governor/Legends|governor]], and later as a [[Moff/Legends|moff]].

==Biography==
By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Zerex was an elderly man. He served as the governor of the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]], and also had dealings with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Draba]]. However, Zerex was ambitious and planned to make a bid to become a [[Moff/Legends|moff]]. To support his bid, Zerex arranged to bring the suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizer [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bythen Forral/Legends|Bythen Forral]] to justice, by sending a group of freelance agents to sabotage [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] computers on Forral's [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]], sending the Captain on a one-way course to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

The agents were successful and Zerex took credit for their actions, using his resulting popularity to secure himself an appointment as the Moff of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. To celebrate, Zerex held a party at his mansion on Ord Adinorr and invited a number of individuals to attend, including the business owner [[Greddin Zel]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] banker [[Brult Kiais]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bornet Lorax]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Meren Siefel]], his mistress [[Klorma Draill]], his assistant Captain [[Piedell]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] band [[The Vortices]] and the freelance agents who had dealt with Forral. However, he didn't invite Draba, as he thought that it would be inappropriate if he was seen socializing with criminal figures. She disliked this, as she had invested a lot of time and money in Zerex, so she hired the freelance agents to blackmail Zerex and remind him of his commitments to her.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Not satisfied with his new power, Zerex aimed to become a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]], and dream came true just a few months later. Zerex's inauguration was due to take place on the planet [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] and he arrived there the day before the ceremony, staying in the luxury [[Royal Hotel]]. However, Draba learned that Zerex had promised to crack down on [[racketeering]] when he became a Grand Moff, making him a potential threat to the Hutt. Draba didn't believe that she could risk letting the appointment happen, so she hired the freelance agents again and sent them to Boreleias, to assassinate Zerex.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
